description: Read the user's LinkedIn message history (DMs) with one person, from their imported LinkedIn export: every conversation that person is in, oldest first, with who sent each message and its full text. Use for 'what did I message Sander?', 'did she ever reply?', 'show me my LinkedIn thread with Tom' and before drafting a follow-up to someone the user has messaged. Pass a name or a LinkedIn profile URL. If the name matches several people it returns candidates to choose from.

limit.description: How many of the most recent messages to return (default 60, max 150).

person.description: The person's name as it appears on LinkedIn, or their profile URL.

name: get_linkedin_conversation
title: Read LinkedIn messages
